title: REQ · Global readable pixel typography on a dark background
summary: Base styles give every screen a dark background, light text, VT323 body text and Press Start 2P headings.
description: Context: styles.css only declares CSS variables and frame classes; body has no background, colour or font size, so unstyled pages render black on white in the default font look. Desired behavior: a base layer that sets background, text colour, VT323 body at 20px and Press Start 2P headings. Expected result: all screens are readable by default. Why: readability.
acceptance_criteria: Given styles.css, when parsed, then body sets background to var(--sf-color-ink-1) and color to var(--sf-color-parchment-5).
Given styles.css, when parsed, then body uses font-family var(--sf-font-body) with font-size 20px and h1, h2 use var(--sf-font-pixel).
technical_constraints: Reference token variables defined by tokensToCssVars in src/lib/tokens.ts
definition_of_done: Base rules exist in styles.css and the unit test passes
non_functional: VT323 is small at default size, so base size is 20px
